meta.title: A price round can be moved to auction only once
gaps: The available read operations cannot verify that no second auction round exists.
The available vocabulary cannot verify that a new move becomes allowed after the first auction is withdrawn or cancelled.

words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event, published, with one QA vendor invited; bidding open for about 20 minutes.
steps: The buyer converts the pricing round to a live auction first.
The buyer sends the request that converts a round into an auction, exactly as the matching library case writes it.
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with “An auction has already been made for this event.”, and never with a server error.
